adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` to iterate over each destination calendar and create an event per destination/credential. However, `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` now destructures only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`) and uses that for `createEvent` (and similarly in `createAttendees`, `updateEvent`, `deleteEvent`). This means when `event.destinationCalendar` contains multiple entries (e.g., team/collective flows added in `handleNewBooking.ts` that push team members' destination calendars), Lark event creation for non-first destinations will still target the first calendar externalId, so those hosts' own calendars won't receive their events (and events may be created in the wrong calendar instead).
